verdict.rationale: The evidence shows usage-based pricing and meter events for billing customers on usage, plus generic webhooks, a customer portal and aggregate analytics. None of it documents real-time current-cycle usage or accrued-cost visibility for customers or teams, and none documents usage thresholds or alerts before invoicing. Meters and webhooks are developer building blocks, and proration previews are an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, customers and my team can see current-cycle usage and accrued cost in real time, with thresholds and alerts before an invoice surprises anyone
